name: hud_ui_composite_panel_entry_constructor_copy
description: HudUiCompositePanelEntry::ConstructorCopy delegates the panel slice to HudUiPanel::CopyConstructCore, copies the seven trailing flash fields, and installs the transition-text-panel ftable.
known_limits: Depends on HudUiPanel::CopyConstructCore, which is functionally accepted but still carries inherited copy/font-clone byte-shape drift.

VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?ConstructorCopy@HudUiCompositePanelEntry@@QAEPAU1@PBU1@@Z at 0x4bc410 still fails: 13 unmasked mismatches, 4 relocation bytes masked, 7 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, Binary Ninja body is 111 bytes and the VC object symbol is 112 bytes. The remaining drift is the final transition text-panel ftable install to 0x4cd388, which retail emits after the flash-field copy.
tier_s_evidence: Binary Ninja shows HudUiPanel::CopyConstructCore, flash field copies at offsets 0x2a4 through 0x2bc, final ftable install to g_HudUiTransitionTextPanel_FTable, and thiscall return of self.
The native composite-entry smoke validates ConstructorCopy return value, installed transition-text ftable, copied panel fields, and copied flash fields.
